items.title: BREAKTHROUGHS
items.text:
BREAKTHROUGHS
When you find a lab, check its box and gain its ability.
☐ OPAL When you do the Make Supplies action, take 1 additional Supply cube if you are in a haven or supply center.
☐ JADE Remove a maximum of 1 Supply cube during step 2 of each Epidemic card.
☐ TOPAZ Discard a Player card matching the color of a just-drawn Infection card to prevent 1 Supply cube from being removed from that city.
☐ PEARL Unknown. A possible cure?

rules: When you find a lab, check its box and gain its ability. All four boxes are printed empty.
OPAL: When you do the Make Supplies action, take 1 additional Supply cube if you are in a haven or supply center.
JADE: Remove a maximum of 1 Supply cube during step 2 of each Epidemic card.
TOPAZ: Discard a Player card matching the color of a just-drawn Infection card to prevent 1 Supply cube from being removed from that city.
mechanics.effect: Board legend for the four labs. Checking a lab grants its printed ability. Pearl has no ability yet.

items.title: Area 13 placement
items.text: Put this sticker on the game board onto Area 13.

mechanics.effect: Place the Breakthroughs sticker on Area 13 of the game board.

summary: Breakthroughs legend for Area 13. Opal adds 1 Supply cube on Make Supplies in a haven or supply center. Jade removes at most 1 Supply cube during step 2 of each Epidemic. Topaz discards a matching-color Player card to save 1 Supply cube from a just-drawn Infection card. Pearl reads: Unknown. A possible cure?
